source_caption:
🎥🎬: President Curtis 

President Curtis is the charismatic and ambitious leader of the United States in the chaotic universe of Rick and Morty. Unlike many politicians in the series, Curtis presents himself as a capable and confident figure, often finding himself caught between protecting Earth and dealing with the unpredictable influence of Rick Sanchez.

His complicated rivalry with Rick leads to constant clashes of intelligence, ego, and power. Whether facing alien threats, political challenges, or Rick’s reckless schemes, President Curtis proves he is one of the few people capable of standing his ground against the smartest man in the universe.

source_details.title: President Curtis
source_details.synopsis: President Curtis is an American adult animated science-fiction comedy television series created by James Siciliano and Dan Harmon for Adult Swim. A spin-off of Rick and Morty, based on the character of the same name by Wes Archer and Tom Kauffman, the series follows Andre Curtis, the president of the United States, and his staff as they respond to interdimensional, paranormal and other unexplained crises. Keith David reprises his role as Curtis, with Stephanie Beatriz and Jim Rash also starring. Adult Swim announced the series at San Diego Comic-Con in July 2025, following a surprise appearance by David during the Rick and Morty panel. The series premiered on July 26, 2026, with new episodes
